text: Good evening. I'm minding my granddaughter, she's 5, and she has a temperature of 38.6 and has had runny poos a couple of times today. She's drinking plenty and weeing as normal. I'll confess I had a fright at bathtime, purple marks all over her legs, but they came off with the flannel. Turns out she'd been colouring herself in with felt tips! So that's that. Probably silly of me but is there anything I should do about the temperature and the tummy?
